integrity: The analytic proof uses an exhaustive support-face classification, ruled-surface quadrature, the divergence theorem, and a support-function radius calculation; finite numerical checks are supplementary and do not establish the continuum identity.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the convex hull of exactly three congruent, concentric disks in the three mutually perpendicular coordinate planes. Not a statement for general plane triples, unequal radii or higher collections. Published equivalences may still exist under alternative names; the 2020 CHoCC article was only partially accessible.
title: Exact intrinsic volumes and boundary decomposition of the orthogonal three-disk hull
